content.json:
# D365 F&O · Integration Health & Telemetry Discovery
This Azure Workbook queries the **selected Application Insights resource** without a separate ADX cluster.

**Discovery-first:** The workbook does not assume that any particular external integration emits telemetry. Check the **Data Readiness** and **Event Discovery** panels before treating downstream charts as meaningful.

Built-in F&O telemetry can include DMF events and X++ exceptions when configured. Generic Application Insights `requests`, `dependencies`, and `traces` may be empty for Microsoft-managed F&O or may include unrelated applications. No F&O integration end-to-end delivery guarantee is implied.

**Workflow:** choose resource and incident time, examine discovered source/event/operation names, enter an optional integration term, inspect errors/latency, and correlate by OperationId where the ID is actually propagated.

**Interpretation:** A missing event ≠ a successful transaction, and a successful HTTP request ≠ successful business processing. No instrumentation keys or environment details are stored in this template.

parameters.name: OperationIdFilter
parameters.label: Optional operation ID for correlation view

content.json:
## 1 · Data readiness and actual event discovery
These queries read the telemetry available **at runtime** in your Application Insights resource. They cannot infer signals that a vendor or service has not sent.

content.query:
let begin={TimeRange:start};let finish={TimeRange:end};
union
 (customEvents | where timestamp between (begin .. finish) | summarize Records=count() | extend Source="customEvents"),
 (requests | where timestamp between (begin .. finish) | summarize Records=count() | extend Source="requests"),
 (dependencies | where timestamp between (begin .. finish) | summarize Records=count() | extend Source="dependencies"),
 (traces | where timestamp between (begin .. finish) | summarize Records=count() | extend Source="traces"),
 (exceptions | where timestamp between (begin .. finish) | summarize Records=count() | extend Source="exceptions")
| project Source,Records,Observation=iff(Records>0,"Received telemetry","Not observed in selected interval")
| order by Source asc
content.title: Data readiness — telemetry sources
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
customEvents | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| summarize Events=count(),LastSeen=max(timestamp) by EventName=name
| top 300 by Events desc
content.title: All custom event names
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
customEvents | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| extend d=customDimensions
| extend IntegrationLabel=coalesce(tostring(d.IntegrationName),tostring(d.Partner),tostring(d.SourceSystem),tostring(d.TargetSystem),tostring(d.InterfaceName))
| extend EnvironmentId=coalesce(tostring(d.EnvironmentId),tostring(d.environmentId))
| where isempty('{EnvironmentIdFilter:escape}') or EnvironmentId=='{EnvironmentIdFilter:escape}'
| where isempty(term) or name contains term or IntegrationLabel contains term
| summarize Events=count(),FirstSeen=min(timestamp),LastSeen=max(timestamp),WithActivityId=countif(isnotempty(tostring(d.activityId))) by EventName=name, IntegrationLabel,EnvironmentId
| top 200 by Events desc
content.title: Candidate integration custom events
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

items.name: query - Custom event property key discovery (no values)

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
customEvents | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term
| extend Keys=bag_keys(customDimensions)
| mv-expand Key=Keys to typeof(string)
| summarize PropertyOccurrences=count(),SampleEvent=take_any(name) by PropertyName=Key
| top 150 by PropertyOccurrences desc
content.title: Custom event property key discovery (no values)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
requests | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term
| summarize Calls=count(),Failures=countif(tostring(success)=~"false"),LastSeen=max(timestamp) by RequestName=name,Role=cloud_RoleName
| top 150 by Calls desc
content.title: Request operation names (observed)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
dependencies | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term or target contains term or type contains term
| summarize Calls=count(),Failures=countif(tostring(success)=~"false"),LastSeen=max(timestamp) by DependencyName=name,Target=target,Type=type,Role=cloud_RoleName
| top 150 by Calls desc
content.title: Dependency targets (observed)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.json:
## 2 · HTTP / dependency activity and health
The graphs count **observed telemetry**, not orders, retries, or partner acknowledgments. Request and dependency calls remain distinct to avoid double-counting.

items.name: query - Observed request and dependency traffic (adaptive 2-series timeline)

content.query:
let s={TimeRange:start};let e={TimeRange:end};let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
let bucket=max_of(1,tolong(ceiling(toreal((e-s)/1m)/180.0)));
union
 (requests | where timestamp between (s .. e) | where isempty(term) or name contains term | project timestamp,Kind="Incoming requests",Failed=(tostring(success)=~"false")),
 (dependencies | where timestamp between (s .. e) | where isempty(term) or name contains term or target contains term or type contains term | project timestamp,Kind="Outgoing dependencies",Failed=(tostring(success)=~"false"))
| summarize Events=count(),FailureSignals=countif(Failed) by TimeUtc=bin(timestamp,bucket*1m),Kind
| order by TimeUtc asc
content.title: Observed request and dependency traffic (adaptive 2-series timeline)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

items.name: query - Request outcome and P95 duration

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
requests | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term
| summarize Calls=count(),Failures=countif(tostring(success)=~"false"),P95Ms=round(percentile(toreal(duration/1ms),95),1) by RequestName=name,Role=cloud_RoleName
| extend FailurePercent=round(100.0*Failures/Calls,1)
| top 100 by Failures desc,Calls desc
content.title: Request outcome and P95 duration
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

items.name: query - Dependency outcome and P95 duration

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
dependencies | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term or target contains term or type contains term
| summarize Calls=count(),Failures=countif(tostring(success)=~"false"),P95Ms=round(percentile(toreal(duration/1ms),95),1) by DependencyName=name,Target=target,Type=type
| extend FailurePercent=round(100.0*Failures/Calls,1)
| top 100 by Failures desc,Calls desc
content.title: Dependency outcome and P95 duration
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';let threshold=toreal('{SlowMs:escape}');
dependencies | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or name contains term or target contains term or type contains term
| extend DurationMs=toreal(duration/1ms)
| where DurationMs>=threshold
| project TimeUtc=timestamp,Name=name,Target=target,Type=type,DurationMs,Success=success,ResultCode=resultCode,OperationId=operation_Id,Role=cloud_RoleName
| top 200 by DurationMs desc
content.title: Slow outgoing dependencies (threshold)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

items.name: query - Most recent failed request / dependency signals

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
union
 (requests | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where tostring(success)=~"false" | where isempty(term) or name contains term | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Request",Name=name,Target="",ResultCode=resultCode,DurationMs=toreal(duration/1ms),OperationId=operation_Id),
 (dependencies | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where tostring(success)=~"false" | where isempty(term) or name contains term or target contains term or type contains term | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Dependency",Name=name,Target=target,ResultCode=resultCode,DurationMs=toreal(duration/1ms),OperationId=operation_Id)
| top 250 by TimeUtc desc
content.title: Most recent failed request / dependency signals
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.json:
## 3 · Error diagnostics / supported F&O DMF evidence
An exception is an application-side signal, not guaranteed evidence of an external partner failure. The DMFError query is relevant to integrations involving Data Management; it does not cover every OData call.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
customEvents | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where name == "DMFError"
| extend d=customDimensions
| extend Project=tostring(d.DataProjectName),Entity=tostring(d.EntityName),ExecutionId=tostring(d.ExecutionId),EnvironmentId=coalesce(tostring(d.EnvironmentId),tostring(d.environmentId))
| where isempty('{EnvironmentIdFilter:escape}') or EnvironmentId=='{EnvironmentIdFilter:escape}'
| where isempty(term) or Project contains term or Entity contains term or tostring(d.ErrorCategory) contains term
| project TimeUtc=timestamp,Project,Entity,ExecutionId,BatchJobId=tostring(d.BatchJobId),Category=tostring(d.ErrorCategory),Message=tostring(d.ErrorMessage),ActivityId=tostring(d.activityId)
| top 250 by TimeUtc desc
content.title: F&O DMFError events (if enabled)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
exceptions | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isempty(term) or outerMessage contains term or type contains term
| project TimeUtc=timestamp,ExceptionType=type,MessagePreview=substring(outerMessage,0,350),Method=method,OperationId=operation_Id,Role=cloud_RoleName
| top 200 by TimeUtc desc
content.title: Application exceptions (observed)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.query:
let term='{IntegrationTerm:escape}';
traces | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end})
| where isnotempty(term) and message contains term
| project TimeUtc=timestamp,MessagePreview=substring(message,0,250),Severity=severityLevel,OperationId=operation_Id,Role=cloud_RoleName
| top 200 by TimeUtc desc
content.title: Matching traces (search term required)
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.json:
## 4 · Individual operation timeline
Paste a real `operation_Id` from a request/dependency result into the Operation ID filter. If the ID is not propagated across services, this view cannot link events between them.

items.name: query - Operation ID correlation across telemetry types

content.query:
let id='{OperationIdFilter:escape}';
union
 (requests | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotempty(id) and operation_Id==id | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Request",Name=name,Outcome=tostring(success),Detail=tostring(resultCode),OperationId=operation_Id),
 (dependencies | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotempty(id) and operation_Id==id | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Dependency",Name=name,Outcome=tostring(success),Detail=strcat(target," / ",resultCode),OperationId=operation_Id),
 (exceptions | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotempty(id) and operation_Id==id | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Exception",Name=type,Outcome="Error",Detail=substring(outerMessage,0,250),OperationId=operation_Id),
 (traces | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotempty(id) and operation_Id==id | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Trace",Name="Trace",Outcome=tostring(severityLevel),Detail=substring(message,0,250),OperationId=operation_Id),
 (customEvents | where timestamp between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotempty(id) and operation_Id==id | project TimeUtc=timestamp,Kind="Custom event",Name=name,Outcome="Event",Detail="",OperationId=operation_Id)
| order by TimeUtc asc
| take 500
content.title: Operation ID correlation across telemetry types
content.noDataMessage: No telemetry observed under these filters. This is NOT proof that the integration is healthy.

content.json:
## 5 · Next instrumentation / limitations

This workbook is **not** an authoritative message-reconciliation dashboard. Successful HTTP responses do not prove business processing; no telemetry does not prove health. For reliable missing messages and retry analysis, you need correlated send/receive/acknowledge signals on both ends.

Recommended custom event fields: **IntegrationName, Direction, CorrelationId, Operation, Outcome, RetryCount, DurationMs**, and a non-sensitive MessageId. Use explicit terminal statuses and do not emit customer data, secrets, message payloads, or order details.

Service Bus dead-letter queues, vendor logs, and external e-commerce systems require their own instrumentation or a permitted cross-resource query. This workbook operates only on the selected App Insights resource.

**Validation status:** structural JSON and parameter checks only; event presence and query runtime must be verified by opening the workbook in your Azure tenant.
